description: This effort is for the delivery of aviation security screening equipment to three (3) international (OCONUS) airports; Nadi international Airport (NAN), Nadi, Fiji; Cassidy International Airport (CXI), Kiritimati, Kiribati; and Faleolo International Airport (APW), Apia, Samoa.  The contractor will be required to supply all components, ship, deliver, install, and integrate (if applicable), and test and commission the equipment.  The contractor will also be required to provide consumables (if applicable); manuals, maintenance guides, and maintenance/testing kits (if applicable); and limited manufacturer equipment operation and maintenance training to local aviation staf
